notes: Contraction paired with grammar-replace-0013: removes the original fact that Russian is officially written in the Cyrillic alphabet (cardinality:many has_official_script, stored). Russian has only one official script, so no second held value exists; the cardinality item instead asks the super-property written_in_script (is Russian written in Cyrillic: yes before and after), which the removal leaves untouched. A many-valued contraction here would need a subject with two official scripts, such as Serbian. Derived: the script of the official language of Russia (binding) and whether Ukrainian shares the script (composition). Related: whether Bulgarian is written in the alphabet Russian is officially written in (yes; a stored fact about a different language, Bulgarian, reached through the edited fact; after the removal it is not known).
